title: The next conversation
passage: Tomorrow will bring another chance to ask, explain, listen or share something. I can choose one thing to explore without deciding in advance how every word will sound. The conversation will involve another person too. We will discover part of it together.
steps: Read aloud once in your ordinary way.
Choose one feature or tool to explore.
Read the same text again with that one choice.
Save one observation and one real-life use.
reflection: What changed in effort or meaning?
